name: Responsive Industries Limited
remarksWeb: The names of Mr. Abhishek Agarwal and Mrs. Saudamini Agarwal has been added to comply with NSE letter dated 13.04.2022 (Ref: case number 118) for reclassification of Promoters under Regulation 31A
revisionRemark: With reference to your email dated 13th April, 2022, We would like to clarify the following points:    1. The Company (Responsive Industries Limited) had submitted an application for Re-classification of Promoters of Mr. Abhishek Agarwal and Mrs. Saudamini Agarwal under regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 to NSE on 11th January, 2021 vide application no. 118. The Company had been continuously answering to every query raised by the NSE relating to the application. The last query raised by your good office dated 4th February, 2021 was duly addressed by the Company on 9th February, 2021.    2. Further, thereafter the status of the application on the NEAPS website was showing Closed and no further query was raised by your good office for a period of more than one year, until your email dated 13th April, 2022 asking for new requirements with respect to the application.    3. Due to re-opening of the application by your good office all the shareholding patterns submitted by the Company during the quarter ended 31-Mar-2021, 30-Jun-2021, 30-Sep-2021, 31-Dec-2021 and 31-Mar-2022 are now showing as incomplete.    4. As your good office had not raised any query with respect to the application during the said period (more than one year )and the application status on the NEAPS website was showing as Closed, the Company submitted the shareholding patterns keeping in mind that the application has been approved. Further BSE Limited (designated stock exchange) has already approved the application.     Further, the Company requests your good office to kindly clarify the reason for keeping the application closed for more than one year and opening the same for revision.    Request your good office to kindly take the same on your record and oblige.
